title: Preview and apply a safe fix

steps.title: Prerequisites
steps.body: demo/ open in Godot 4.3+ (mono), addon enabled, bridge running. Proves the mutate -> gate -> fix loop with the one shipped Safe:true provider, remove_missing_script (resolves missing_scripts|missing_script). It stages a copy of the committed missing-script fixture under _ValidationSuite/m10-fix/. Run validate first to obtain the exact issue_id, then dry-run the fix, then apply under gate: enforce.

steps.title: Apply the fix under gate: enforce
Expected outcomes
items: validate_edit reports missing_script (Error); copy its issue_id verbatim into the fix prompts (the illustrative issue_id in the payload must match the real key).
Dry-run returns the fix description and Safe: true and makes no disk mutation.
Apply (dry_run: false, gate: enforce) removes the broken script attachment and the gate re-validation shows no new errors.
A follow-up validate_edit on the same path no longer reports missing_script.

reset.note: Deletes the staged fixture tree (_ValidationSuite/m10-fix/). Canonical demo/Fixtures/ are never modified.
